title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02112v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations by matching the teacher's token probabilities. These probabilities entangle two kinds of information: which tokens the teacher prefers, and how confident it is. The latter reflects the teacher's own capacity and calibration, which a smaller student may be unable to reproduce. Because the teacher temperature changes these values without changing the ordering, OPD is also sensitive to the temperature choice. We ask whether the teacher's ordering of candidate tokens is enough, and propose Order-Only On-Policy Distillation (O$^{3}$PD). At each student-generated prefix, O$^{3}$PD trains the student to reproduce the order of the teacher's top-$K$ tokens, without fitting their probability values. The objective is therefore invariant to the teacher temperature and needs no temperature tuning. Across six teacher--student pairs, O$^{3}$PD outperforms OPD on the average over HMM

translated_abstract: 同策略蒸馏通过匹配教师模型的词元概率，在学生模型自身生成的文本上对其进行训练。这些概率纠缠了两种信息：教师模型偏好哪些词元，以及它对这些词元的置信程度。后者反映了教师模型自身的能力与校准水平，而较小的学生模型可能无法复现。由于教师温度会改变这些概率值但不改变其排序，OPD 对温度的选择也十分敏感。我们探究教师模型对候选词元的排序是否已经足够，并提出了仅顺序同策略蒸馏。在学生模型生成的每个前缀处，O³PD 训练学生模型复现教师模型 top-K 词元的排序，而无需拟合其概率值。因此该目标对教师温度具有不变性，无需温度调节。在六个教师-学生模型组合上，O³PD 在 HMM 平均表现上优于 OPD。
tldr: 提出仅顺序同策略蒸馏（O³PD），只让学生模型学习教师模型 top-K 词元的排序而不拟合概率值，因此对教师温度不变、无需温度调节，并在多个教师-学生组合上优于传统同策略蒸馏。
en_tdlr: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation (O³PD) trains the student to reproduce only the teacher's top-K token ordering instead of fitting probability values, making it invariant to teacher temperature, requiring no temperature tuning, and outperforming standard on-policy distillation across six teacher-student pairs.
